Seer.directive_rationale: communicate your role immediately if you survive
Seer.actual_player_behavior: Hoang immediately stated, 'I am the Seer,' at the start of the Day 1 debate.
Seer.verdict_notes: The player revealed their role immediately upon surviving the first night.

Seer.directive_rationale: ensure the Guard knows your priority
Seer.actual_player_behavior: Hoang revealed their role and shared their investigation result on Nhan, but did not explicitly instruct the Guard to protect them.
Seer.verdict_notes: While the Seer revealed their role, they did not take any specific action to ensure the Guard knew the Seer was the priority for protection.

Guard.directive_rationale: Prioritize the Seer above all else
Guard.verdict_notes: The Guard protected themselves instead of the Seer (Hoang).

Guard.directive_rationale: The Guard and Witch did not coordinate their save resources
Guard.actual_player_behavior: Nhan chose to protect Hoang; there is no record of communication or coordination with Cong (the Witch) regarding save resources.
Guard.verdict_notes: The Guard acted independently without coordinating with the Witch.

Witch.directive_rationale: The Guard and Witch did not coordinate their save resources
Witch.actual_player_behavior: Cong used the SAVE potion on Cong; there is no record of communication or coordination with Nhan (the Guard).
Witch.verdict_notes: The Witch acted independently without coordinating with the Guard.

Witch.directive_rationale: Use your poison more aggressively once a 'fatal error' (attacking a cleared player) is identified
Witch.actual_player_behavior: Cong identified a 'fatal error' by Meg in Round 1 and campaigned for her exile, but did not use the poison potion during the Night phases of the game.
Witch.verdict_notes: Although the trigger (identifying a fatal error) occurred during the Day 1 debate, the Witch never used the poison potion in any subsequent night.

Villager.directive_rationale: the total absence of Seer data makes early rush-exiles risky
Villager.verdict_notes: Seer data was available immediately in Round 1 (Hoang confirmed Nhan), so the trigger condition was not met.

Villager.directive_rationale: Focus on detecting 'safe-echoing'—wolves who agree with the village process to blend in
Villager.actual_player_behavior: Jin accused Riley of 'Safe-Echoing' and suggested voting for Riley.
Villager.verdict_notes: Jin identified Riley's behavior as safe-echoing and acted by accusing them.
